visual.general_description: Color micrograph of stained cells on a pink-white background.
visual.detailed_description: Densely magenta-purple stained field of mixed nucleated cells. Many cells have round to oval dark purple nuclei with coarse chromatin and a thin rim of lighter cytoplasm; several have segmented or lobulated nuclei; a few small dark condensed cells are present. Pale pink-beige anucleate red cells and one pink elongated structure at the upper right are visible. No scale bar, labels, arrows, text or panel letters are visible.

visual.detailed_description: Purple-blue stained field of nucleated cells among pale pink red cells and scattered small granules. Several cells have round, eccentrically placed dark purple nuclei with abundant blue cytoplasm; others have segmented nuclei with pink cytoplasm. Two black arrows point at individual cells, one in the upper middle and one at the lower left of centre. No scale bar, text or panel letters are visible.
